scope: Cashflow Blotter missing timeout dialog; direct source inspection only.
executions: NOT_RUN by this source-investigation agent; parent owns browser execution.

facts.claim: Home schedules the prompt at access-token exp and reconciles access/refresh expiry on visibility return.
Unrelated loader and business-state updates do not change the scalar token/exp/ready popup dependencies.
Base reducer updates hooksBase and public hooks on each action. Cashflow Blotter creates a Redux Provider, not another base Provider.
Successful /extend response changes access token and exp, resetting the popup deadline. Ordinary business responses and refresh-token acquisition do not enter this access-token handling branch.
Previously visited workspace children remain mounted when their panels become hidden.
Blotter and Dashboard have separate routes. Blotter installs fulfilled-GraphQL session-extension middleware.
Blotter notification STOMP/SockJS heartbeats, buffered publishing, and local row updates do not call the inspected GraphQL extension middleware.
The Dashboard has a two-minute repeat-query loop. It requires that separate tile to have mounted.
Timeout starts logout immediately when no refresh exists; logout proceeds after a one-second wait. A late observation can miss the prompt.
A TOKEN_INVALID_EXPIRED error clears credentials and routes away from Home, bypassing sustained prompt observation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Actual access expiry keeps moving because eligible extensions occur.
hypotheses.control: Capture only redacted request identity, extension count, access exp, current time, and dialog state. Compare Blotter-only idle against actual loaded-tile traffic.
hypotheses.decisive_result: Repeated successful /extend responses move exp before its deadline; blocking that cause in an authorized local control permits expiry.

hypotheses.hypothesis: A previously opened background tile continues renewal while Blotter is selected.
hypotheses.control: Fresh session with only Blotter versus visit the renewing tile, then switch to Blotter. Retain mounted tile inventory and request initiators.
hypotheses.decisive_result: Hidden mounted tile renews credentials; removing that tile stops those renewals and permits the prompt.

hypotheses.hypothesis: The prompt appears briefly and auto-logout precedes the user return.
hypotheses.confidence: Source-supported under missing/expired refresh; actual session outcome unknown.
hypotheses.control: Observe DOM plus analytics modal-open/close events around expiry. Record later Sign in and credential-cleared state separately.
hypotheses.decisive_result: Prompt creation followed by one-second logout, rather than never-created prompt.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Actual deployed artifact or token lifetime differs from inspected source/defaults.
hypotheses.control: Bind loaded base artifact URL/hash, module versions, session exp timing, and import-map identity. Do not retain raw credentials.
hypotheses.decisive_result: Deployed code or actual exp differs from the locally reviewed source/expected deadline.

hypotheses.hypothesis: The popup timer is suppressed despite fixed expired access.
hypotheses.confidence: Not explained by inspected scalar dependencies.
hypotheses.control: Fresh Blotter-only session, no post-init renewal, known access exp, usable long refresh. Observe continuously across visible idle and return from hidden state.
hypotheses.decisive_result: No dialog after fixed expiry with Home still mounted and credentials unchanged would isolate a lifecycle/runtime defect.

bounded_search.result: No recurring GraphQL poll or automatic focus refetch found in these Blotter paths. This does not establish absence from deployed modules.
